										
αValves
=============
!!DEPRECATED

Controls the water flow of the SAMPLER by providing distinct programs. Controls the valves and pumps on the board

## Maintanance
 - Clean glass reservoir when needed 
 - Calibrate scale (not ready yet): 
     - Empty reservoir completely by pressing (-) button for some seconds on the Î±Valves
       and press the "empty" button
     - Go to tools page and press "calibrate" and enter 0 in the dialog
     - Fill 500ml from a measuring jug into the reservoir and click "calibrate" again. 
       Enter this time 500 in the dialog
     - Press empty again, but make sure you have enough timeout. Press (OK) to reset the timeout timer.

Troubleshooting:
---------------
In case of a communictation error:
 - stop program by pressing (OK) and (ESC) for three seconds
 - navigate in the menu to serial communication
 - enable serial communication
 - do the same for Î±Valves
 - unplug and plug the yellow power cord


Program:
----------
alphaValves.vls

Port
-----
/dev/ttyUSB1

Display lines
---------
 1. Actual weight, actual duration
 2. Target weight, timeout duration
 3. Current job
 4. Warnings

Usage
-------
 - +/- changes target weight in digital units
 - Up/Down changes timeout in seconds
 - Left/Right changes valve
 - (OK) resets timeout
 - (ESC) or I13 stops everything
 - I8 changes fridge bit
 - I9 starts back flush (pump backward through valve until timeout)
 - I10 starts  flush (pump forward from valve to throughflow intruments (ProPS, YSI600R) until timeout)
 - I11 starts fill (pump forward from valve to reservoir until active weight=target weight)
 - I12 starts empty (open empty valve and empty pump until active weight=target weight)
 - I14 & I15 Water Alarm sensor (reset water alarm by (ESC))

Outputs
-------
 1. Pump forward
 2. Pump backward
 3. 3/2 Valve throughflow / reservoir
 4. Reservoir empty: 2/2 Valve and pump
 5. 3/2 Valve: Fridge or waste 
 6. Valve block 1
 7. Valve block 2
 8. Valve block 3
 9. Valve block 4 (unused)
 10. (E01) Sample valve 1
 11. (E02) Sample valve 2
 12. (E03) Sample valve 3
 13. (E04) Sample valve 4
